newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 eases at opening on Dow loss, awaits data.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 eases at opening on Dow loss, awaits data.

text.p: The FTSE 100 began Thursday's session weaker, tracking modest losses for the Dow last night, dealers said.
The U.S. index was 12.77 points off by the New York close at 7,290.69, having posted a 12-point gain at London's close.
The FTSE 100 was 11 points lower at 4,631 by 0735 GMT.

"There's no appetite for more rises as we get nearer and nearer the budget and a little dip in U.S. related stocks and drugs is all it needs to take the market off," said a dealer, referring to an expected first, mini-budget from the new Labour government in early June.
